takeHomeAssumptions.note: Transparent 2026/27 England PAYE sketch for the nurse only (NHS pension). Private renter has no pension deduction in this model. Not official tax tables.

renter.incomeNote: Modelled inner-London professional salary for the scenario, not ASHE/median. Tenure mix (36.2% PRS) is 2018.
